# Lansdown Foundry

> Lansdown Foundry is a font maker for iPad and Mac. Draw letters with Apple Pencil, a mouse, a trackpad or a graphics tablet, and they become a real, installable font.

Available now on the App Store for iPad and Mac.

Key facts:

- Platform: iPad with Apple Pencil (iPadOS 18 or later) and Mac with Apple silicon; universal purchase
- Price: £19.99, paid once; no in-app purchases, no subscription
- Privacy: no account, no ads, nothing collected; fonts sync through the user's own iCloud Drive
- Included typefaces: Suffolks (book serif), Battledown (rounded sans) and Leckhampton (slab serif)
- Developer: Mat Benfield (thechelsuk), made in the UK

## Links

- [Lansdown Foundry website](https://lansdownfoundry.thechels.uk/): the official marketing site
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/lansdown-foundry-make-fonts/id6817508991): download the app
- [Privacy policy](https://thechels.uk/app/privacy): what the app does and does not collect
- [Project page](https://thechels.uk/projects/foundry): background from the developer

## Features

- Draw letters with a calligraphic nib using Apple Pencil
- Trace a stencil or start from scratch
- Key letters generate related letters and accents
- Balls, curls and swashes on any stroke
- Automatic spacing and kerning
- Bold, Italic and Bold Italic generated from your drawing
- Install fonts or export TrueType, WOFF and WOFF2
- iCloud Drive sync between iPad and Mac

## FAQ

### Can I turn my handwriting into a font?

Yes. Draw each key letter with Apple Pencil and Lansdown Foundry builds a complete font from your handwriting, with related letters, accents, spacing and kerning.

### What font formats can I export?

TrueType (TTF) to install on any computer, and WOFF and WOFF2 for websites. You can also install fonts directly on your iPad or Mac.

### Do I need to know about type design?

No. Start from a stencil and trace. The app handles the technical side: metrics, kerning, weights and italics.

### How much does it cost?

£19.99, paid once. One purchase covers iPad and Mac, with no in-app purchases and no subscription.

### What do I need?

An iPad with Apple Pencil running iPadOS 18 or later, or a Mac with Apple silicon.
